question: Which offices may read topic graphs, expertise and dependency analyses, resilience indexes and succession reports computed from exit interviews, and does a derived figure or label inherit the reader floor of the most sensitive interview it was computed from?
decision: Derived data inherits the highest source classification, unless produced from a correctly filtered set authorized for the particular reader; do not disclose a sensitive source through label, small-cell counts or inference. Consent restrictions also propagate into aggregated, embedded, cached and model-derived outputs. Lower-floor queries must recompute over an authorized subset, never reuse an all-level aggregate.
originalProposedDecision: Yes: a derived figure or label inherits the reader floor of the most sensitive interview it was computed from. Aggregates for a lower floor are computed only from interviews at or below that floor.
